title: Comparison of Plasma Dynamics in Coronal Holes and Quiet Sun Using Flux Emergence Simulations
evidence_note: The authors synthesize line intensity, velocity, and width for spectral lines they explicitly identify as observed by IRIS.

title: Formation of Si IV due to the interaction of an electron beam with the flaring solar chromosphere
evidence_note: The paper calculates synthetic Si IV 1402.8 Angstrom intensities and profiles and explicitly relates them to the IRIS spectral window and exposure times.

title: SPACE-SUIT: An Artificial Intelligence Based Chromospheric Feature Extractor and Classifier for SUIT
evidence_note: The authors analyze observed IRIS Mg II k full-disk mosaics and transform them into mock SUIT NB3 images at the same Mg II k wavelength, so both observational and synthetic use count under the agreed passband rule.

title: Bifrost Models of the Quiet Sun. I. Comparison with Solar Observations
evidence_note: The paper directly uses IRIS quiet-Sun observations and explicitly computes synthetic Mg II k and Si IV observables for comparison, so both observational and synthetic use count.

title: Observational Analysis of Multithermal Counterstreaming Flows in a Forming Filament and Their Relationship with Local Heating at Filament Footpoints
evidence_note: The analysis uses IRIS slit-jaw images and calibrated Level-2 spectra of the filament.

title: Origin of the Unusual Composition of 3He-rich Solar Energetic Particles
evidence_note: The event was seen by IRIS, but the paper did not use the IRIS data because the slit was in the wrong place at the relevant time. Availability or mention without analysis is not data use.

title: Ellerman Bombs at High Resolution. IV. Visibility in Na I and Mg I
evidence_note: The paper analyzes SST Na I and Mg I observations; IRIS results belong to an earlier paper and are mentioned for context.

title: Prediction and Verification of Parker Solar Probe Solar Wind Sources at 13.3 Solar Radii
evidence_note: IRIS appears only as an example observatory and in the bibliography; the paper does not use IRIS data or IRIS-observable synthetic data.

title: Automated Detection of Solar Eruptions
evidence_note: The work uses SDO/AIA; IRIS is mentioned only for automatic cross-referencing and possible subsequent studies.

title: Scientific Objectives and Capabilities of the Coronal Solar Magnetism Observatory
evidence_note: The paper describes IRIS capabilities while motivating COSMO but does not analyze IRIS data or create synthetic IRIS observables.

title: The Dynamics of the Extreme Ultraviolet Quiet Sun and Coronal Holes in the Solar Orbiter Era
evidence_note: This is a review that summarizes IRIS-based results from other papers without presenting new IRIS observational or synthetic analysis.

title: The Impact of the Angle-average Approximation in the Partial Frequency Redistribution Modeling of the Mg II h-k Doublet Stokes Profiles
evidence_note: The paper synthesizes Mg II h-k Stokes spectra, including intensity, within the IRIS NUV window. Its modeling is tied to CLASP2 rather than IRIS, so the synthetic connection to IRIS is inferred from the passband even though IRIS is mentioned in the background.

title: Formation of Jet-driven Forced Reconnection Region and Associated Plasma Blobs in a Prominence Segment
evidence_note: The paper expands IRIS as Infrared Interferometer in Space, while the present analysis uses SDO/AIA and STEREO/EUVI data. It neither analyzes target-mission IRIS observations nor creates synthetic IRIS observables.
